title: Attackers Pick the Target, AI Does the Rest: Cyber Predictions for 2027
content_md: Attackers are handing more of their work to AI. Next year could bring the first major breach in which the victim’s own AI agents do most of the attacker’s work. Article Link: https://www.security.com/threat-intelligence/cyber-ai-predictions-2027
